seo.title: Schema editing, ER diagrams and database compare
seo.description: Change table structure with a DDL preview, read a schema as an ER diagram, compare two databases into a sync script, and copy tables to another engine.

header.title: Schema and database comparison
header.lead: Inspect table relationships, change supported table structures and compare databases before applying a sync script.

sections.title: Edit table structure
paragraphs: Edit columns, indexes, foreign keys and CHECK constraints in the Structure tab. Review pending DDL with <ui>Preview SQL</ui>. Destructive changes, type changes, NOT NULL and primary-key changes require confirmation even at {macSafeModeDefault}.

Create tables with a live SQL preview. Foreign-key changes on SQLite-family engines may require a table rebuild. TablePro runs confirmed rebuilds on SQLite and local libSQL; on Turso, remote libSQL and Cloudflare D1, you run the generated script yourself.

sections.title: ER diagram
paragraphs: <ui>View ER Diagram</ui> shows tables and foreign-key relationships with crow's-foot notation. Export as PNG or SQL, or copy the diagram as an image.
The diagram is read-only, not a schema designer. Make changes in the Structure tab.

sections.title: Database objects
paragraphs: Inspect supported routines and triggers in read-only source tabs, then copy their SQL or open it in the editor. Object listings vary by engine. PostgreSQL partitions appear under their parent table.

blocks.title: Folders for tables and views
paragraphs: Group tables and views with drag-and-drop or <ui>Move to</ui>. Folders change only the sidebar, not the database, and sync between Macs when iCloud Sync is enabled.

sections.title: Compare & Sync
paragraphs: Compare schema or data between a source and target database. Include views, routines and triggers where supported. Data comparisons match rows by key, with filters and row limits for each table.
Review a generated sync script ordered by foreign keys. Destructive changes stay excluded until you allow them for that run. Read-Only connections cannot be targets. Save comparisons for reuse.

sections.title: Copy and transfer tables
paragraphs: Copy To moves supported objects and data between databases, including across engines. Review DDL, row counts and type conversions first. Conversions can lose constraints: MariaDB ENUM becomes PostgreSQL VARCHAR without its allowed-value list.
Duplicate Database copies a database on the same connection. Transfer To maps rows into an existing table on another connection without an intermediate file. These tools are free.

sections.title: Users, sessions and maintenance
paragraphs: Table maintenance, such as VACUUM and REINDEX on PostgreSQL or OPTIMIZE and CHECK on MySQL, shows its SQL before it runs. Databases and schemas can be created, dropped and renamed from the sidebar where the engine supports it.

blocks.title: Users & Roles
paragraphs: Inspect privileges from server to column level on supported engines. Stage grants and revokes, then review their SQL before applying them.

blocks.title: Server Dashboard
paragraphs: The Server Dashboard shows live sessions, server metrics and slow queries, refreshed at the interval you pick. Where the engine allows it, cancel a running query or terminate a session from its row; both go through the connection’s Safe Mode. On SQLite, DuckDB and Typesense it shows metrics only.

sections.title: On iPhone and iPad
paragraphs: The iPhone and iPad app shows a table’s columns, indexes and foreign keys, read-only. From the table list you can truncate or drop a table on a SQL engine, unless the connection is Read-Only.
Structure editing, the ER diagram, Compare & Sync, Copy To, Users & Roles and the Server Dashboard are in the Mac app only.

availability.label: Structure editing with a DDL preview
availability.iosNote: Columns, indexes and foreign keys, read-only

availability.label: Copy To, Duplicate Database and Transfer To

limits: Compare & Sync writes a structure script only between two databases of the same engine, with MySQL and MariaDB counted as one. Other pairs compare read-only, MongoDB structures never get a script, and a data sync across engines warns you to check how values are written. To move tables to another engine, use Copy To.

Reordering columns rebuilds the table on SQLite and on a local libSQL file, after you confirm. On PostgreSQL, Turso, remote libSQL and Cloudflare D1, TablePro writes the rebuild script and leaves running it to you.
The ER diagram is read-only. It is not a schema designer.
The sessions and query text the Server Dashboard can show depend on the privileges of the account you connect with.
